name: Sanluri (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sanluri (a red castle on white) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Sanluri, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Sanluri arms — red castle on white, crowned, within branches
